item.title: Homeless man stabbed in Hanover
item.description: A homeless man in Hanover was stabbed in the face and upper body and police are asking for anyone with information to come forward. Hanover Police Service said in a Feb. 27 news release that the assault happened on Feb. 25 at 9:30 p.m. near the intersection of 10th Avenue and 12th Street in Hanover. […]

item.title: West Grey turns out to see its new police station Saturday
item.description: The new police station meets today’s policing standards and allows officers to provide the best service possible to the community, West Grey Police Chief Jeremy White said.

item.title: Walkerton District Riverhawks punch ticket to OFSAA
item.description: The Walkerton Riverhawks senior boys' basketball team are CWOSSA champions, and now hope to keep the medals coming at the provincial championships.

item.title: Milder weather prompts flood warning from Saugeen Conservation
item.description: The Saugeen Valley Conservation Authority is warning of the potential for extremely hazardous conditions and flooding from considerable snowmelt and runoff into local watercourses in the coming days. item.title: Middle East conflict sends shock waves through global fertilizer markets
item.description: Exports from the Arab Gulf normally exceed 1.5 million tonnes of urea per month, meaning even short-term disruptions can quickly tighten global supply
